_role: The autonomy loop's POSTURE — the only thing a cycle reads before deciding whether to start (architecture §4.2 step 1). Written by the budget governor, read by research/autonomy/health.py. It is state, not a plan: what the loop is currently doing, never what it should do.
_why_this_lives_in_git: §9 property 2: state lives in git, never in context. A killed session loses nothing but its turn — the next fired cycle re-reads this file and the ledger and continues. There is no resume protocol because there is no in-context state worth resuming.
_backoff_level_means: 0 = full cadence and width. Raised by a cycle that ended without a receipt, lowered by a clean one (§9 property 3). Two dials hang off it: cycle interval (4 h -> 8 h -> 24 h) and subagent width (5 -> 2 -> 1). At level >= 2 the cycle takes only `fetch` and `regrade` items, which are dispatch-and-exit and consume no Claude budget — the loop keeps making progress on a spent budget instead of stopping.
_backoff_since_utc_means: ⛔ STAMPED IN THE SAME WRITE THAT RAISED THE LEVEL, which is what the governor's own contract requires and what `test_a_held_backoff_is_not_reported_as_stuck` measures: the condition is entirely a DURATION, so a level with no start date makes it unanswerable and the row reports BACKOFF-AGE-UNKNOWN rather than a verdict. ★ This raise is the restoration of the pre-sprint floor at `budget_hold.reactivates_utc`, not a failure count — see `budget_hold._RESTORED_2026_09_02_the_sprint_window_closed`.

_subagent_width_means: ⚠ SUPERSEDED AS A CAP BY `_subagent_width_LIFTED_BY_TRIMCRAE_2026_09_02`, RETAINED PER RULE 1.2 BECAUSE THE UNIT IT DEFINES IS STILL THE UNIT. ⛔ THE UNIT IS MAXIMUM CONCURRENT SUBAGENTS, AND IT HAD NEVER BEEN STATED — which is why the cap was unenforceable rather than merely unenforced. Architecture §9 calls it 'parallel width' and the cycle contract says 'launch them in ONE message so they run concurrently', so CONCURRENT is the reading both texts support and it is now written down. The 107-agent incident (40 completed, 67 errored, synthesis lost) was one fan-out launched together, i.e. a concurrent width of 107 against this cap of 5. ⛔ WIDTH MOVES LAST AND MOVES DOWN FASTER THAN IT MOVES UP: 5 -> 2 -> 1 by backoff_level, because the architecture records it as the dial that failed catastrophically. ⚠ WHAT THIS DIAL DOES NOT GOVERN, SAID PLAINLY RATHER THAN LEFT TO BE DISCOVERED: the TOTAL number of subagents a cycle may spend serially. A cycle running 5, waiting, then 5 more, twenty times over, never exceeds this cap and can still exhaust a weekly budget. That total is UNGOVERNED and no number is invented for it here — inventing one would be a remembered figure standing in for a measurement (CLAUDE.md §4). The measurement that would settle it is `utilisation_denominator`, which is null until a window flip is OBSERVED.
_max_cycles_per_session_means: ⛔ THE SESSION-SHAPE CAP, ADDED 2026-08-26 AFTER THE RULE FAILED IN THE WILD. Measured that day: one interactive session ran CYC-0005 and CYC-0006 end to end, compacted 23 times and reached a 7.6 MB transcript, and the rule never fired because it lives in a skill that was never loaded ("name":"Skill" appears 0 times in that session). 2 is a CAP, not a target: one cycle per session is the intended shape and the second is slack for a cycle that turns out to have a small follow-on. The third is the signal that the driver should have spawned. ⚠ It bounds CYCLES, which is a proxy for context and not context itself — a single enormous cycle passes it. The proxy is used because receipts already carry `session_id` and nothing in this repository can read a context window, and an imperfect measurement that fires beats a perfect one that does not exist.
_start_point_means: §9.2's start point, and it is DELIBERATELY BELOW TARGET: the controller's first job is to measure the ceiling by approaching it, not to find it by hitting it. Dials move in this order of preference — cycle frequency first (it is smooth), then items per cycle, and only then subagent width. Width moves last and moves down faster than it moves up: the 107-agent fan-out that hit the weekly cap (40 completed, 67 errored, synthesis lost) was a WIDTH failure, not a depth one.
_utilisation_target_means: trimcrae, 2026-08-26 (D3): 'about 80% of the max budget', leaving ~20% as his interactive headroom. A target for the CONTROLLER, never a floor for the WORK — an empty queue means an idle loop, not make-work to hit a number.
_utilisation_denominator_means: UNKNOWN, and it stays null until a window flip is OBSERVED. `rate_limit_info` returns a verdict (`status`, `rateLimitType`, `resetsAt`, `isUsingOverage`), not a quota, so how much of the window REMAINS is not readable (§9.1). The denominator is therefore CALIBRATED, not assumed: the loop records the consumption at which `status` last flipped away from `allowed`, and THAT observed figure becomes this number. Inventing one would put a fabricated denominator underneath every utilisation reading the controller takes — an absent reading is not a reading of absence (CLAUDE.md §4), and §9.2 is explicit that the loop says UNKNOWN rather than guessing.

last_limit_flip._means: The first OBSERVED flip of rate_limit_info.status away from `allowed`. Recorded by CYC-0088-f7394a99 from a child session's own rate_limit_info. ⛔ IT SUPPLIES NO DENOMINATOR: `allowed_warning` is a verdict, not a quota, so `utilisation_denominator` stays null. budget_hold._means: ⛔⛔ A BUDGET HOLD IS NOT A BACKOFF, AND THE GOVERNOR HAD NO WAY TO SAY SO UNTIL NOW. `backoff_level` is defined as a FAILURE counter — raised by a cycle that ended without a receipt, LOWERED BY A CLEAN ONE. So a level raised for budget reasons is undone by the first cycle that goes well, which is exactly the cycle you least want to license the next six. This block is the missing half: it pins a FLOOR under `backoff_level` that a clean cycle may not decrement through, and it carries its own reason and expiry.

budget_hold._review_after_utc_means:
⛔ AN EXPIRY INTO A REVIEW, NOT INTO FULL CADENCE. Past this stamp the hold is not lifted — a cycle must take a FRESH utilisation reading and write it to `last_utilisation_report` before clearing it. With no fresh reading the correct move is ONE step down the ladder (level 2 → 1: 8 h, width 2), never a jump back to full: the architecture's rule that a dial moves down faster than it moves up applies to the budget dial too. ⚠ §10.4 also bites here — the loop may not lift its own budget hold merely because the hold is inconvenient to the work it wants to do. A stamp passing is not evidence that the budget recovered.

The previous stamp passed with no weekly reading obtainable, so the hold was RESTORED rather than stepped down and the clock was set forward by the same 72 h it originally carried. ⛔ THAT IS THE ONE MOVE HERE THAT COULD BE ABUSED — a hold whose review date is pushed back every time it is reached is a hold that never reviews — so it is bounded: the re-stamp accompanied a STRICTER posture, never a looser one, and a cycle that re-stamps while loosening any dial is doing the thing §10.4 forbids.

gpu_spend_prohibited._means:
⛔⛔ THIS AUTOMATION RUNS NO GPU WORK. NOT 'cheap GPU work', NOT 'GPU work under the §2 ceiling', NOT 'GPU work that clears the $/ns buy line' — NONE. trimcrae, 2026-09-02, verbatim below, unprompted and in the middle of a cycle that was about to gate a $25.45 rental.
★ IT IS A CATEGORY BAN, NOT A BUDGET, AND THAT DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE POINT. CLAUDE.md §2 makes spend ≲$50 self-doable and §3 sets the review trigger at >$50, so a $25.45 ABFE replicate set reads as authorised on DOLLARS and would be bought by any cycle reasoning from the ceiling alone. It is not authorised, because the constraint he stated is on the KIND of work, not its price. A cheaper GPU job is not a smaller version of an allowed act; it is the same refused act.
⛔ SO THE MONEY GATES DO NOT GRANT ANYTHING HERE. Clearing the $/ns buy line, clearing a rung's dollar ceiling, or finding a free-credit lane are all IRRELEVANT to this: they answer 'is this rate/total acceptable', and he answered a prior question with 'no GPU at all'. A cycle that reaches a CLEARS verdict on the market gate has learned nothing about whether it may buy.
⚠ WHAT THIS DOES NOT SAY, so it is not read wider than it is: it governs THIS AUTOMATION's spend. It does not retire any GPU-dependent route, does not withdraw a past GPU result, and does not close `RT-DEGRADER` — those routes are now held by a standing instruction rather than by a price or a capability, and their records must say THAT rather than 'unpriced' or 'not authorized', which is the stale state that made the selectivity control unresolvable for a month.

usage_throttle._what_is_NOT_being_cut_and_why:
⛔ NOT the publication bar. Narrowing a hardening round from five seats to three would save real tokens and is REFUSED: publish_bar clause 1 forbids a declaring round narrower than the widest earlier one precisely so the loop cannot stop on its weakest look, and cutting seats to save usage is that failure with a budget attached. Cost is a reason to sequence and right-size (CLAUDE.md §5), never to lower a bar.
⛔ NOT the $0 observations, the gates, or CI. They are not what is expensive — the measurement above says so — and cutting them would trade a real protection for no saving.
⛔ NOT live research. CLAUDE.md §0 outranks housekeeping under a throttle exactly as without one; the throttle changes HOW MUCH runs at once, not WHICH work is chosen.
